description: 305's probes for WebMvcTags.outcome(HttpServletResponse): null is a null response; an int is the status a carrier response's getStatus() returns (replay/driver). The brief's list first (null; 99, 100, 199, 200, 299, 300, 399, 400, 499, 500, 599, 600; Integer.MIN_VALUE and Integer.MAX_VALUE), then statuses that test the old path's truncating division by 100 (0, -1, -99, -100, -199, -200, -599) and codes past 599 whose quotient would be a series if it were taken modulo 10 (1000, 1200, 2000) or whose leading digit names a class (1999, 20000).
